 "cells": [

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Plotting pole figures\n",
    "\n",
    "This example shows how to plot pole figures with the `neml2.texture` routines. It\n",
    "loads a crystal plasticity model, uses it to generate reorientation data under\n",
    "rolling, and then plots three kinds of texture figure: a discrete $\\{111\\}$ pole\n",
    "figure, a discrete inverse pole figure, and a continuous $\\{111\\}$ pole figure\n",
    "from a reconstructed orientation distribution function (ODF). Along the way it\n",
    "shows how to reconstruct a continuous ODF from discrete orientations, including\n",
    "cross-validated selection of the kernel half-width.\n",
    "\n",
    "The model is the approximated single-crystal formulation in\n",
    "[`crystal_approximated.i`](crystal_approximated.i) (the same input used by\n",
    "the [formulations example](formulations)); it is integrated with\n",
    "[pyzag](https://github.com/Argonne-National-Laboratory/pyzag). See the\n",
    "[pyzag tutorial](#tutorials-optimization-pyzag) for\n",
    "more on the pyzag driver.\n",
    "\n",
    "```{note}\n",
    "This is a heavier example (500 crystals, 2500 time steps) and is committed\n",
    "pre-executed; it runs on the GPU when one is available.\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Setup\n",
    "\n",
    "This example simulates rolling in an FCC material: `rate` is the strain rate,\n",
    "`total_rolling_strain` the reduction strain, `ntime` the number of time steps,\n",
    "`ncrystal` the number of random initial orientations, and `nchunk` the pyzag\n",
    "time-integration chunk size."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:25:49.016871Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:25:49.016403Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.740823Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.739056Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Using device: cpu\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "\n",
    "import neml2\n",
    "from neml2.types import MRP, SR2, WR2, Scalar\n",
    "from neml2.pyzag import NEML2PyzagModel\n",
    "import neml2.texture as texture\n",
    "from pyzag import nonlinear, chunktime\n",
    "\n",
    "torch.manual_seed(0)\n",
    "torch.set_default_dtype(torch.double)\n",
    "device = torch.device(\"cuda:0\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
    "print(f\"Using device: {device}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "nchunk = 20\n",
    "ncrystal = 500\n",
    "\n",
    "rate = 0.0001\n",
    "total_rolling_strain = 0.5\n",
    "ntime = 2500\n",
    "end_time = total_rolling_strain / rate"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The rolling history is the same isochoric stretch used in the formulations\n",
    "example: extension along $y$, contraction along $z$, no spin. The 500 initial\n",
    "orientations are sampled uniformly on $SO(3)$ with `MRP.rand`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.745328Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.744611Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.831666Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.830590Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "deformation_rate = torch.zeros((ntime, ncrystal, 6), device=device)\n",
    "deformation_rate[:, :, 1] = rate\n",
    "deformation_rate[:, :, 2] = -rate\n",
    "deformation_rate = SR2(deformation_rate)\n",
    "vorticity = WR2(torch.zeros((ntime, ncrystal, 3), device=device))\n",
    "times = torch.linspace(0, end_time, ntime, device=device).unsqueeze(-1).expand(ntime, ncrystal)\n",
    "\n",
    "initial_orientations = MRP.rand(ncrystal, device=device)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Integrate the rolling deformation\n",
    "\n",
    "The pyzag driver below uses the `NEML2PyzagModel` to pack the typed force\n",
    "tensors into the model's flat force layout (`assemble_forces`) and the initial\n",
    "conditions into the flat state vector (`assemble_state`), integrates the history\n",
    "with the chunked adjoint solver, and slices the final orientation back out."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.834215Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.833968Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.839560Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.838806Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def integrate(pmodel, forces, seeds):\n",
    "    flat_forces = pmodel.assemble_forces(forces)\n",
    "    state0 = pmodel.assemble_state(seeds)\n",
    "\n",
    "    solver = nonlinear.RecursiveNonlinearEquationSolver(\n",
    "        pmodel,\n",
    "        step_generator=nonlinear.StepGenerator(nchunk),\n",
    "        predictor=nonlinear.PreviousStepsPredictor(),\n",
    "        nonlinear_solver=chunktime.ChunkNewtonRaphson(rtol=1.0e-6, atol=1.0e-8),\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    return nonlinear.solve_adjoint(solver, state0, len(flat_forces), flat_forces)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def extract(pmodel, history, name):\n",
    "    offset = 0\n",
    "    for var in pmodel.slayout.vars():\n",
    "        size = pmodel.slayout.var_size(var)\n",
    "        if var == name:\n",
    "            return history[..., offset : offset + size]\n",
    "        offset += size\n",
    "    raise KeyError(name)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.840984Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:25:52.840796Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.013326Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.012434Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "/var/folders/9p/j85ydv4n2370tksq_dprk81h0000gn/T/ipykernel_52981/668052336.py:5: UserWarning: pyzag lowered torch._functorch.config.donated_buffer's default to False process-wide. AOTAutograd 'donated buffers' (torch>=2.12) are incompatible with pyzag's retain_graph=True adjoint over torch.compile'd models, which otherwise raises 'compiled with non-empty donated buffers'. To keep donated buffers enabled, restore torch._functorch.config._config['donated_buffer'].default = True -- compiled models differentiated through the adjoint will then error.\n",
      "  solver = nonlinear.RecursiveNonlinearEquationSolver(\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "final orientations: (500, 3)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "nmodel = neml2.load_nonlinear_system(\"crystal_approximated.i\", \"eq_sys\")\n",
    "nmodel.model.to(device=device)\n",
    "pmodel = NEML2PyzagModel(nmodel)\n",
    "\n",
    "with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "    history = integrate(\n",
    "        pmodel,\n",
    "        {\"deformation_rate\": deformation_rate.data, \"vorticity\": vorticity.data, \"t\": times},\n",
    "        {\n",
    "            \"elastic_strain\": torch.zeros(ncrystal, 6, device=device),\n",
    "            \"slip_hardening\": torch.zeros(ncrystal, device=device),\n",
    "            \"orientation\": initial_orientations.data,\n",
    "        },\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "orientations = MRP(extract(pmodel, history, \"orientation\")[-1])\n",
    "print(\"final orientations:\", tuple(orientations.data.shape))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Discrete pole figure\n",
    "\n",
    "Plot a discrete $\\{111\\}$ pole figure of the final orientations under cubic\n",
    "crystal symmetry (`\"432\"`). Each crystal contributes its symmetry-equivalent\n",
    "$\\{111\\}$ poles projected onto the unit disk."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.015835Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.015391Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.130680Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.129160Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "texture.pretty_plot_pole_figure_points(\n",
    "    orientations, torch.tensor([1.0, 1.0, 1.0], device=device), crystal_symmetry=\"432\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.title(\"Discrete {111} pole figure\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Discrete inverse pole figure\n",
    "\n",
    "An inverse pole figure shows which crystal directions align with a chosen sample\n",
    "direction — here the transverse direction $[0, 1, 0]$."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.135159Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.134679Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.200332Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.198861Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "texture.pretty_plot_inverse_pole_figure(\n",
    "    orientations, torch.tensor([0.0, 1.0, 0.0], device=device), crystal_symmetry=\"432\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.title(\"Inverse pole figure (transverse direction)\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## ODF reconstruction\n",
    "\n",
    "Reconstruct a continuous ODF from the discrete orientations with a kernel density\n",
    "estimate. The de la Vallee Poussin kernel half-width is selected by\n",
    "cross-validation; we print the optimized value."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.203736Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:27:24.203605Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:27:45.665733Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:27:45.663311Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "optimized kernel half-width: 0.1469\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "odf = texture.KDEODF(\n",
    "    orientations, texture.DeLaValleePoussinKernel(torch.tensor(0.1, device=device))\n",
    ")\n",
    "odf.optimize_kernel()\n",
    "print(f\"optimized kernel half-width: {float(odf.kernel.h.detach()):.4f}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Continuous pole figure\n",
    "\n",
    "Use the reconstructed ODF to plot a smooth, continuous $\\{111\\}$ pole figure. The\n",
    "contour values are in multiples of a random distribution (MRD)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:27:45.670245Z",

     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:27:54.634552Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:27:54.632870Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",

       "<Figure size 640x480 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"

   ],
   "source": [
    "texture.pretty_plot_pole_figure_odf(\n",
    "    odf,\n",
    "    torch.tensor([1.0, 1.0, 1.0], device=device),\n",
    "    crystal_symmetry=\"432\",\n",
    "    limits=(0.0, 3.0),\n",
